name: Exp_BlauHLM
summary: This EA trades based on the BlauHLM (Ergodic Histogram) indicator by William Blau, supporting three signal modes: zero-line breakdown, histogram twist, and cloud twist. It opens and closes positions systematically based on momentum signals from the custom indicator's multiple smoothing layers.
summary_zh: 该EA基于William Blau的BlauHLM（遍历直方图）指标进行交易，支持三种信号模式：零线突破、直方图扭转和云图扭转。它根据自定义指标多层平滑处理后的动量信号系统性地开仓和平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于William Blau的Ergodic HLM指标，这是一种多层平滑的动量振荡器。策略提供三种入场模式：breakdown模式在直方图穿越零线时开仓——多方直方图从负转正时做多，从正转负时做空；twist模式在直方图方向发生扭转时开仓，即连续三个柱的直方图变化方向反转时触发信号；cloudtwist模式则比较上轨和下轨两条线的交叉来产生信号。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose），同时设置了固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持按固定手数或按账户保证金比例计算仓位。资金管理使用MarginMode枚举选择手数模式，默认0.1的比例。策略使用了多达四层不同长度的平滑处理来过滤噪声，这减少了假信号但也增加了滞后性。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on William Blau's Ergodic HLM indicator, a multi-layer smoothed momentum oscillator. Three entry modes are provided: breakdown mode triggers when the histogram crosses the zero line — going long when it turns positive and short when it turns negative; twist mode triggers on histogram direction reversal, requiring three consecutive bars to confirm a momentum shift; cloudtwist mode compares the crossover of upper and lower cloud lines to generate signals. Exit conditions rely on opposing signals closing positions (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose), combined with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, which defaults to 0.1, supporting either fixed lot size or margin-proportional calculation via the MarginMode enum. The strategy employs up to four smoothing layers with different period lengths (XLength1-4) to filter noise, which reduces false signals but also increases lag. Money management uses the LOT/FIXED margin mode selection for flexible risk allocation.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 风险比例或手数，控制仓位大小
parameters.description_en: Money management percentage or fixed lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式：固定手数或按保证金比例
parameters.description_en: Money management mode (free margin/balance/free margin after loss/balance after loss/fixed lot)

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 交易信号模式：突破/扭转/云图扭转

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取信号的K线索引

pros: 三种信号模式提供灵活性，适应不同市场环境
多层平滑处理有效过滤短期噪声，减少假信号
支持9种平滑算法（SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX等），可针对不同品种优化
独立的做多/做空开仓和平仓开关，便于精细控制交易方向
有NewBar检测机制，避免同一K线内重复交易
pros_en: Three signal modes provide flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Multi-layer smoothing effectively filters short-term noise and reduces false signals
Supports 9 smoothing algorithms (SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX etc.) for optimization across instruments
Independent buy/sell open and close switches enable fine-grained directional control
NewBar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar
cons: 多层平滑导致信号滞后严重，可能错过最佳入场时机
止损1000点和止盈2000点固定值过大，缺乏根据市场波动率动态调整
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能不利
依赖自定义指标BlauHLM，如果指标文件缺失则无法运行
cons_en: Multi-layer smoothing causes significant signal lag, potentially missing optimal entry timing
Fixed StopLoss 1000 and TakeProfit 2000 points are excessively large without volatility-based adaptation
No position check logic — may open duplicate positions in the same direction
No spread filter — trading in high-spread environments may be detrimental
Depends on custom BlauHLM indicator file — EA fails if the indicator is missing
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整
增加持仓方向检查，避免同方向重复开仓
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，提高交易质量
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic StopLoss/TakeProfit for volatility-adaptive risk management
Add position direction check to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction
Add spread filter and trading session filter to improve trade quality

risk_points: 没有持仓方向检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致过度敞口
固定止损止盈值未考虑品种波动特性，可能不适配所有品种
SignalBar=1默认使用已完成K线，但Recount逻辑在某些情况下可能在当前K线重新计算信号
risk_points_en: No position direction check — may open duplicate positions causing excessive exposure
Fixed SL/TP values don't account for instrument volatility characteristics, may not suit all symbols
SignalBar=1 defaults to completed bar, but Recount logic may recalculate signals on the current bar under certain conditions

summary_en: This EA trades based on the BlauHLM (Ergodic Histogram) indicator by William Blau, supporting three signal modes: zero-line breakdown, histogram twist, and cloud twist. It opens and closes positions systematically based on momentum signals from the custom indicator's multiple smoothing layers.
